solution.title: OAuth & Third-Party App Access Governance for Google Workspace

products.name: OAuth & Third-Party App Access Governance for Google Workspace — Commercial
products.short_description: Establish OAuth & third-party app-access governance for Google Workspace — app/scope inventory, API access control (trusted/limited/blocked, Marketplace allowlist, unverified-app block), token review, and an app-vetting workflow — so only trusted apps reach your data. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Control which third-party apps can touch your Google data

Every user who clicks “Allow” on a third-party app grants it OAuth access to Google data — a huge, mostly invisible attack surface. This solution establishes OAuth & app-access governance: inventory connected apps and their scopes, set API access control (trusted/limited/blocked, Marketplace allowlisting, unverified-app blocking), review high-risk scopes and tokens, and stand up an app-vetting/approval workflow — so only trusted apps reach your data.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run Python (gcloud / Cloud Client Libraries).

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the OAuth risk model: scopes, connected apps, API access control (trusted/limited/blocked), Marketplace allowlisting, unverified-app blocking, and the vetting flow.
  • Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (Workspace super-admin, security/governance stakeholders, risk criteria).
  • Implementation Guide — inventory connected apps + scopes, classify by risk, configure API access control + Marketplace allowlist + unverified-app block, wire an app-approval workflow, and revoke risky grants — pilot-first.
  • 5 Python tools — assessment/discovery, a configuration or provisioning helper, a validation/report generator, a policy/guardrail check, and a scope/config helper — authentic gcloud / Cloud Client Library automation (read-only or dry-run by default; no credentials or keys in code).
  • Validation gates (high-risk scopes controlled, unverified apps blocked, approvals enforced) plus Best Practices for ongoing app-access hygiene.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

The invisible OAuth attack surface brought under control — connected apps inventoried, risky scopes governed, unverified apps blocked, approvals enforced — only trusted apps touch your data.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • Automation Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • api-access-control-helper.py — plan/preview Trusted/Limited/Blocked app access-control changes
    • app-access-validation.py — validate the three OAuth governance gates + emit the review packet
    • oauth-app-inventory.py — inventory connected third-party OAuth apps + scopes for Google Workspace
    • risky-grant-revoker.py — revoke high-risk standing OAuth grants (Token Revocation runbook)
    • scope-config-helper.py — build/validate the OAuth scope-sensitivity reference used for risk scoring

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all Python scripts and tools in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
